notes.title: Weekly Devlog
notes.content:
🎮 [b]Strategy Warriors, Greetings![/b] 🐾 Another week of [b]blazing keyboards[/b], [b]bug hunting[/b], and [b]fresh upgrades[/b] at [b]Slap Games HQ[/b]! Let’s just say [b]sleep was optional[/b]. 😅 Here’s what’s new in [b]Godstone Tactics[/b]—ready? Let’s dive in!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185284/96124cf44a5b231d29f3278ca8ee8059d6701ed1.png[/img]

🌟 [b]New Features & Improvements[/b]
🏆 [b]ELO System Overhaul![/b]
* Your [b]ELO score will never drop below zero![/b]
* [b]Starting ELO is now 1000[/b], and [b]scores are multiplied by 20[/b] for better balance.
🎮 [b]In-Game Notification Panel Added![/b]
* Someone sent a [b]match invite[/b]? [b]Friend request[/b]?
* All [b]notifications now appear in the top-left corner![/b]
* [b]Click to accept or decline.[/b] 👌
⚙️ [b]Settings Upgraded![/b]
* [b]Toggle animations on/off![/b]
* [b]Screenshake effects are now optional.[/b] [b]Screen shake lovers, we’ve got you covered.[/b] 😌
🔊 [b]New SFX![/b]
* The [b]Squirrel character now has a unique sound when thrown![/b] 🐿️✨ [b]A tiny hero’s farewell![/b]

🛠 [b]Bug Fixes & Technical Tweaks[/b]
🌐 [b]Discovery Mode Stabilized![/b]
* [b]Fixed crashes[/b] when entering Discovery while matchmaking.
* [b]Addressed issues where Discovery wouldn’t work after the first game.[/b] [b]Explore stress-free now![/b]
🐇 [b]Rabbit Targeting Indicator![/b]
* A [b]floating arrow now hovers over rabbits![/b]
* [b]Arrows stay visible until the character is played,[/b] [b]bobbing up and down[/b]—adorably tactical!
🐰 [b]Bunny Death Glitch Fixed![/b]
* There was a bug where a bunny didn’t “[b]say goodbye[/b]” properly… 🙏 [b]Fixed! Now every bunny falls heroically.[/b]
📌 [b]Minor Adjustments & Polish[/b]
* [b]Smoother performance[/b] thanks to code refactoring.
* [b]Visual transition tweaks.[/b]
* [b]Micro-changes to enhance user experience.[/b]

🎯 [b]Growing With Our Community![/b] [b]Your feedback shapes Godstone Tactics![/b] [b]Spotted a bug? Have ideas?[/b] Join us on Discord! 👉 https://discord.gg/Zjxk3MRx
[b]May your strategies be many and your victories plentiful![/b] 🏆 [b]– The Slap Games Team[/b]
